name: Steal a Snack 🍔
desc:
👋 Welcome to Steal a Snack

😉 Buy snacks of different rarities from the map
💸 Earn money online & OFFLINE from snacks
😈 Steal snacks from other Players
🥷Be careful, there are snack thieves
🖐️ Buy slaps, and other weapons to defend yourself
⭐ Rebirth for bigger rewards

👍 Like the game, and join the group to support us!
❤️ Made with love by FastPixels
